solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Mum's dog shortly returned, catching coat in tree

indicators.note: returned says the letters from mum's and the shortened dog are read backwards

parts.note: Mum's gives MA'S, mother's, with the apostrophe dropped

indicators.note: shortly says the dog breed is cut down to its opening letters

parts.note: a labrador is a breed of dog

indicators.note: catching, as in catching what is said, signals a word heard rather than seen

parts.note: an animal's coat is its fur

explanation.surface: A mother's little dog comes back with its coat snagged in a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns MAS + LAB (LABRADOR cut by 'shortly') into BALSAM; 'catching' signals FUR, the coat, heard as FIR.
explanation.definitionFit: The balsam fir is a North American conifer, so it is one kind of tree.

clue.text: Relative missing centre of Iberia that's warmer?

indicators.note: missing says some letters are left out of the relative

parts.note: a brother is a family relative

indicators.note: centre of picks the two middle letters of the six-letter word Iberia

explanation.surface: A relative avoids central Spain, wondering if it is warmer elsewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a definition by example: hot soup warms you up.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot soup is something that heats a person up on a cold day, a definition by example.

clue.text: Most flexible gymnast finally on horse, drained during schedule

indicators.note: during says the other pieces sit inside the schedule word

parts.note: a list is a schedule or timetable

indicators.note: on, in a down clue, puts the gymnast's letter on top of the horse's letters
finally picks out the closing letter of gymnast
drained empties the word horse of its contents, leaving its outside letters

explanation.surface: The bendiest gymnast ends up on the vaulting horse, exhausted, during the programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'horse, drained' looks like a tired gymnast but means the word horse emptied of its middle; 'on' stacks the gymnast's last letter above it.
explanation.definitionFit: Lithe means supple and bending easily, so its superlative means bending most easily.

clue.text: Sign of boredom top priest shows annually reading over Classical passage

indicators.note: reading over, in a down clue, says the whole run of letters is read upwards

parts.note: a yawn is a sign that someone is bored
A1 means first-rate or top, written here as the letters A and I
PA is short for per annum, meaning annually

explanation.surface: A senior cleric yawns through the yearly reading of an old classical text.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top' is A1, written AI. 'reading over' turns YAWN + AI + P + PA upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Appian Way was the great Roman road, a route of classical antiquity.

clue.text: Undercover operators, 20% writing in newspapers etc

parts.note: twenty per cent is one fifth
a column is a regular piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine

explanation.surface: Spies make up a fifth of the writers in the press.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names a group secretly working from within for an enemy: covert agents.

clue.text: Channel showing sport on time

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a sport

explanation.surface: A TV channel is showing sport right on schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: A groove worn into the ground, as by cartwheels, is a kind of channel.

clue.text: Looking over course, Taoism captivates explorer

indicators.note: Looking over says the hidden letters are read backwards
captivates says the words course and Taoism hold the letters within them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: On reflection, a course in Taoist philosophy fascinates a traveller.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'captivates explorer' as the definition, but 'captivates' is what holds the letters in 'course, Taoism'; the definition is 'explorer' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Captain Lawrence Oates was a polar explorer on Scott's Antarctic expedition.

clue.text: Stars performing around carnival site

indicators.note: around says the word for performing goes round the carnival city

parts.note: a performer who is on is performing
Rio de Janeiro is famous for its carnival

explanation.surface: Celebrities are performing at the carnival in Brazil.
explanation.definitionFit: This constellation, the Hunter, is a group of stars in the night sky.

clue.text: Call when riding, but interrupted by mate

indicators.note: interrupted by says the word for but is broken up by the mate

parts.note: tho, short for though, means but
an ally is a friend or mate

explanation.surface: A rider's shout is cut short by a companion.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the cry of fox hunters on horseback when the quarry is sighted.

clue.text: Range that's fashionable to wear in country once shortened

indicators.note: in says the fashionable and wear words sit inside the shortened country
shortened says the old country name loses its last letter

parts.note: Siam was the former name of Thailand
now means trendy or fashionable
to don clothes is to put them on and wear them

explanation.surface: A trendy outfit is worn in a former country that has shrunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Range' suggests a cooker or a spread of goods; here it is a mountain range. 'country once' points to an old name, Thailand's former one.
explanation.definitionFit: This Welsh national park holds the mountains around Snowdon, the highest peak in Wales.

clue.text: As well as new books in middle of room, Dandy's passed round

indicators.note: in puts the new books inside the middle letters of room
middle of takes the two central letters of room

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, the new books of the Bible

indicators.note: passed round says the dandy word is turned about and read backwards

parts.note: a fop is a dandy, a man vain about his clothes

explanation.surface: Besides new books in the room, a dapper man has handed something round.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in addition to, so it is a synonym of besides.

clue.text: One having good look inside couple's green residence

indicators.note: inside says the one, good and look pieces go within the couple word

parts.note: a couple is two
I is the Roman numeral one
lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: Someone glances into the eco-friendly home of a pair of people.
explanation.walkthrough: The word blends twig and igloo: a shelter of woven branches built by environmental protesters, hence 'green'.
explanation.definitionFit: Protesters camping in woods build these woven-branch shelters, an environmentalist's dwelling.

clue.text: Bird cooped around yard meets a wild creature

indicators.note: cooped around says the bird closes in on the yard letter like a pen

parts.note: a hen is a bird

explanation.surface: A penned-up farmyard bird encounters a wild animal.
explanation.definitionFit: This African carnivore, known for its laughing call, is a wild animal.

clue.text: Cliche-ridden newsman abroad ready for rejection by his boss?

parts.note: a hack is a journalist

indicators.note: for rejection says the foreign money word is thrown back, read in reverse

parts.note: ready is slang for cash; foreign cash is the yen, Japan's currency
ED is short for editor, a journalist's boss

explanation.surface: A reporter abroad expects an editor tired of stale phrases to turn him down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ready' is British slang for cash ('the ready'), so 'ready abroad' is foreign money, YEN, which 'for rejection' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing of this kind is stale and overused, so it is full of trite stock phrases.

clue.text: Admin worker agreeable after semi seen somewhere in London

indicators.note: after puts the agreeable word following the half of seen

parts.note: a clerk is an office administration worker

indicators.note: semi means half, here the second half of the word seen

parts.note: well can mean all right or agreeable, as in 'all is well'

explanation.surface: An office worker is happy to follow a half-built house that has been viewed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'semi' means half: the back half of SEEN is EN.
explanation.definitionFit: This district of north central London, in Islington borough, is a place in the capital.

clue.text: Tenants periodically scoff

indicators.note: periodically says every other letter of tenants is taken, at regular intervals

explanation.surface: Tenants now and then jeer.
explanation.definitionFit: To scoff food is to gobble it greedily, a slangy word for consume.

clue.text: Spiritual book recording male, American, probing vices

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play recording
he refers to a male

indicators.note: probing says the American letter pokes into the vices word

parts.note: sins are vices or wrongdoings

explanation.surface: A religious text records a man from the US investigating wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul's letter to the church at Ephesus is a book of the New Testament.

clue.text: One's stirred romance at office, as no work's about

parts.note: to romance someone is to woo them
a den is a private room or study, a kind of office

indicators.note: about says the no and work's letters are turned round

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work; work's gives OP'S without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: An office romance causes a stir because nobody is doing any work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's stirred' is read as 'one has stirred with it': a kitchen utensil.
explanation.definitionFit: A cook mixes the pot with this kitchen utensil, so it is the thing one has stirred with.

clue.text: Novelist's mug that's full of water

parts.note: a stein is a large beer mug
a beck is a northern English word for a stream, something full of water

explanation.surface: The writer's beer mug is filled with water.
explanation.walkthrough: BECK is a northern English dialect word for a brook.
explanation.definitionFit: John Steinbeck wrote The Grapes of Wrath, a famous American author of fiction.

clue.text: Love cryptic clues involving bit of knowledge in climbing shrub

parts.note: honey is a term of endearment, like love

indicators.note: involving says the jumbled clues wrap round the bit of knowledge
cryptic means puzzling or obscure, so the letters of clues are scrambled
bit of takes just the first letter of knowledge

explanation.surface: A sweetheart's puzzle clues contain a little knowledge about a climbing plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cryptic' rearranges CLUES to SUCLE; 'involving' puts K, from 'bit of knowledge', inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Woodbine, a fragrant twining plant, is a vine that climbs hedges and walls.

clue.text: Stand of Swiss rolls centrally alongside steaming tea-urn

indicators.note: steaming, as in steaming drunk, says the letters of tea-urn are mixed up
centrally takes the middle letter of rolls

explanation.surface: Swiss rolls are standing next to a steaming tea urn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'steaming' rearranges TEAURN into NEUTRA. ROLLS has five letters, so its middle one is L.
explanation.definitionFit: Switzerland's famous stance in wars is not taking sides, a position of non-alignment.

clue.text: Duck nursed by parent bird once

indicators.note: nursed by says the duck is held within the parent, like a child in arms

parts.note: ma is a mother, a parent
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so O

explanation.surface: A duckling is cared for by a mother bird of days gone by.
explanation.definitionFit: This flightless New Zealand bird died out centuries ago, an extinct species.

clue.text: Expert layer's sent up, covering in their patio at rear

indicators.note: sent up, in a down clue, says the layer word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a seam is a layer, as of coal in rock

indicators.note: covering takes the outside letters of their, its cover
at rear picks out the last letter of patio

explanation.surface: A skilled bricklayer goes up to lay a covering at the back of a family's patio.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent up' turns SEAM upwards to MAES; 'covering' gives TR, the outside of THEIR; 'at rear' gives O.
explanation.definitionFit: A master of an art, especially a musical conductor, is a highly skilled specialist.

clue.text: Wine, light type, Gino drunk in hospital

indicators.note: in says the light and shuffled name go inside the hospital word

parts.note: san is short for sanatorium, a hospital
UV is ultraviolet, a type of light

indicators.note: drunk says the letters of Gino are jumbled

explanation.surface: Gino gets tipsy on a light white and lands in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: This grape variety gives its name to a popular dry white drink from the vineyard.

clue.text: Indirectly express son's to go alone

indicators.note: to go says the son letter must leave the word for alone

parts.note: simply can mean only or alone

explanation.surface: A hint that a son is going off by himself.
explanation.definitionFit: To suggest something without saying it outright is to hint at it, a synonym.

clue.text: The difference between lad and lady? Very much

definitions.text: The difference between lad and lady?
definitions.meaning: lad is lady with its last letter cut off, so the two differ by a missing tail
an informal idiom meaning a great deal

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading is cryptic: take the final Y off LADY and LAD remains.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an informal idiom for to a great extent, as in 'it helped enormously'.

clue.text: Pipe initially discharging — bucket's put underneath

indicators.note: put underneath, in a down clue, places the bucket word below the first letter
initially takes the first letter of discharging

parts.note: to bucket is to pour with rain

explanation.surface: A pipe starts leaking, so a bucket goes under it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bucket' is the verb, as in 'it's bucketing down': pouring with rain.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a pipe or channel carrying waste water away from a building.

clue.text: Stay in Asian country, after leader's removed incidentally

indicators.note: in says the stay word goes inside the reduced country
leader's removed says the first letter of the Asian country is dropped

parts.note: Laos is a country in South-East Asia
a prop is a support or stay

explanation.surface: A visit to a South-East Asian nation, once its leader has gone, mentioned by the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stay' is a support, not a visit. 'leader's removed' cuts LAOS to AOS.
explanation.definitionFit: Used on its own, the word means by the way or speaking of which, a synonym.

clue.text: Animal which guzzles plant

definitions.meaning: a female pig, a greedy feeder
to put seed in the ground

explanation.surface: An animal that is eating a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A female pig is a greedy farm animal, and scattering seed in soil is planting it.

clue.text: What Academy must do regularly to create a star

parts.words: What Academy must do regularly to create
parts.note: the Royal Academy must from time to time vote in new Royal Academicians, known by the letters RA

explanation.surface: An academy's routine business is turning someone into a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for a Royal Academician; the Academy must periodically choose new ones, since members retire at 75, so the clue reads as ELECT + RA.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra is one of the Pleiades, the Seven Sisters cluster in Taurus.

clue.text: Familiar type of army sortie

definitions.meaning: the ... Army is an informal name for the Salvation Army, a Christian charity
a sudden rush out by troops from a besieged position

explanation.surface: A well-known kind of military force makes a raid.
explanation.definitionFit: The Salvation Army's nickname supplies one sense; a sudden charge out of a fortress is the other.

clue.text: Famous spring currently in possession of two knights

parts.note: a well is a spring of water

indicators.note: in possession of says the two knights hold the currently word between them

parts.note: K and N are both abbreviations for knight, N in chess notation
now means currently, at present

explanation.surface: A celebrated spa now belongs to a pair of knights.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone recognised by many people is celebrated, a direct synonym.
